title: there's no point in -ing, it's worth -ing etc.
subtitle: no point in, worth, trouble, spend time и go -ing

theory.text: There's no point in doing, It's no use doing, It's no good doing — нет смысла, бесполезно: There's no point in shouting. It's no use crying. В вопросе — the point of: What's the point of shouting?

items: It's worth doing / It's not worth doing: It's not worth waiting.
Предмет тоже может «стоить»: This album is worth listening to.
It's worth it — оно того стоит: It was expensive, but it was worth it.

head: Схема
Пример
rows: have trouble / difficulty / a problem doing
We spent an hour looking for the keys.

theory.text: go + -ing — для занятий спортом и досугом: go fishing, go skiing, go camping, go shopping, go jogging. He's gone fishing. Have you ever been camping?
Русское «у меня проблемы с поиском» не переводится как trouble to find — только trouble finding. И «пойти поплавать» — это go swimming, а не go to swim.
